description_en: Enables the service log feature for a project
kebab_example: aliyun sls create-logging --project ali-test-project --logging-project my-project --logging-details type=consumergroup_log logstore=my-logstore --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLogging

parameters.description_en: The name of the project to which service logs are stored.
parameters.description_zh: 服务日志要保存到的Project名称。
parameters.help_en: The name of the project to which service logs are stored
parameters.help_zh: 服务日志要保存到的Project名称
parameters.name: logging_project

element_fields.description_en:
The type of service logs. Valid values:

- consumergroup\_log: the consumption delay logs of consumer groups.

- logtail\_alarm: the alert logs of Logtail.

- operation\_log: the operation logs.

- logtail\_profile: the collection logs of Logtail.

- metering: the metering logs.

- logtail\_status: the status logs of Logtail.

- scheduledsqlalert: the run logs of Scheduled SQL jobs.

- etl\_alert: the run logs of data transformation jobs.
